intro_paragraphs: A failed rooftop unit (RTU) can shut down a dining room, overheat a kitchen, or make a retail floor unusable. Frost Fire Heating and Cooling provides commercial RTU repair in Raleigh, NC and throughout the Triangle — diagnosing package units, heat pumps, and gas/electric rooftop systems that restaurants and light commercial buildings rely on every day.

We handle the failures that show up in real searches: RTU not cooling, short cycling, tripped breakers, frozen coils, failed compressors, ignition problems, and economizer issues. Our goal is simple — restore comfort and airflow fast, with clear pricing and minimal disruption to your customers.
Looking for rtu repair Raleigh NC or rooftop unit repair near me? Call (919) 230-4439. We are open after hours and Sundays with no extra charge.
cards_h2: Rooftop Unit Problems We Diagnose & Repair
cards_h2_html: Rooftop Unit Problems We Diagnose & Repair

cards.title: RTU Not Cooling
cards.body: Low airflow, dirty coils, refrigerant issues, failed compressors, or condenser fan failures that leave the space hot.

cards.title: Heating / Ignition Failures
cards.body: Gas heat ignition problems, limit trips, and heat exchanger concerns that leave offices and dining rooms cold.

cards.title: Electrical & Control Board Issues
cards.body: Tripped breakers, bad contactors, failed capacitors, and control boards that keep the unit from starting.

cards.title: Blower & Airflow Problems
cards.body: Weak supply air, clogged filters, belt issues, and economizer dampers stuck open or closed.

cards.title: Restaurant Kitchen Load Stress
cards.body: RTUs fighting kitchen heat, hood make-up air imbalance, and systems that can't keep up during peak service.

cards.title: After-Hours Commercial Emergencies
cards.body: Nights and weekends — we respond when a failed RTU would otherwise force you to close early.

faqs.q: Do you charge more for weekend RTU service?

faqs.q: Can you service restaurant rooftop units?

faqs.q: What if the RTU needs replacement instead of repair?
faqs.a: We will tell you honestly when repair no longer makes sense and outline replacement options with clear pricing.
